name: Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: One-Man Shows
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should be a native of Tamil Nadu by continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
1. The applicant should have continuous involvement in his/her field of painting and sculpture.
1. The applicant should possess an adequate number of artworks for the conduct of his/her show.
1. Participation in National or State level Art Exhibitions and Artists Camps will be considered as an additional qualification.
